title: North Korea displays drones, missiles as Kim urges AI weapons push
paragraphs: North Korea displays drones, missiles as Kim urges AI weapons push

South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff said its military detected "around a dozen short-range ballistic missiles fired from the Wonsan area of North Korea towards the East Sea", also known as the Sea of Japan.

SEOUL: North Korea has test-fired attack drones, missiles and a multiple rocket launcher at a weapons demonstration, state media reported on Friday (Oct 30), as leader Kim Jong Un called for faster development of drone and AI technology for military use.
